label: Small terrarium
lead: Glass terrarium measuring 30x28x28 cm with a handmade 3D background. Volume: 23.5 liters, horizontal format. Handmade in Novi Sad.
imageAlt: Glass terrarium 30x28x28 cm with 3D background - NS Reptiles

description.html: The almost cubic shape, 30x28x28 cm, gives 840 cm² of floor and about 23.5 liters. Compared with the 30x20x25 model it is 8 cm wider, which is a big difference in small terrariums: one more hide fits. A 3D styrofoam background covers the back.

Leopard and fat-tailed geckos at the juvenile stage use the floor, so they need a warm hide on one side and a cool one on the other, with a gap that the 28 cm width barely allows. A young crested gecko gets 28 cm of height for a branch and a plant. A small corn snake can stay here for its first few months.

If you like this shape, the larger versions are the 30x30x30 and 40x40x40. When ordering you choose whether the background resembles rock or bark and which film pattern goes on the outside. It goes out by courier to any part of Serbia. A size between these models is built to order, in 7 to 14 days.
